criteria.TC: Technical Correctness — code fix is syntactically correct and addresses the vulnerability
criteria.DS: DRF Specificity — uses DRF-native APIs, not generic Django or incorrect third-party packages
criteria.OA: OWASP Alignment — correctly names and describes the OWASP API Security category
criteria.AC: Actionability — developer can implement without additional research
criteria.ST: Source Traceability — cites verifiable documentation from the knowledge base

rubric.note: Scores represent independent assessment of each recommendation against criteria above

API8-DEBUG-ENABLED.notes: Correct fix (DEBUG=False + ALLOWED_HOSTS); names API8; cites drf_security_guide + owasp docs

API2-NO-PERMISSION.notes: Correct IsAuthenticated pattern; OWASP description inaccurate ('Lack of Resources Protection'); real KB citations

API3-SENSITIVE-FIELD.notes: Idiomatic extra_kwargs pattern; OWASP name slightly off ('Broken Object Level Auth' vs correct 'Broken Object Property Level Auth'); cites write_only/read_only sections

API1-BOLA.notes: Mentions django-rest-framework-guardian (valid extension, not DRF-native); correct OWASP API1 naming; multiple approaches reduce actionability

API4-NO-THROTTLING.notes: Correct rest_framework.throttling built-in config; OWASP description wrong ('Insecure Authentication' vs correct 'Unrestricted Resource Consumption'); cites per-view throttling doc

API8-DEBUG-ENABLED.notes: Correct fix but suggests Sentry (off-topic); no OWASP label; sources explicitly 'none'

API3-SENSITIVE-FIELD.notes: Correct but less idiomatic (CharField vs extra_kwargs); no OWASP label; sources 'none'
